title: WONDERBREAD: A Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal Foundation Models on Business Process Management Tasks

layout.note: Three columns split by vertical black rules, each headed by a big circled number and a bold title. Column 1 is a card stack with a wedge zoom to Demo 3; columns 2 and 3 each hold three tinted rows with dark title bars, each a tuple of inputs, a block arrow and an output.

lesson: State a benchmark as numbered columns that match the caption (dataset, tasks, evaluation); zoom one record out of a card stack with a wedge and split it with plus signs, and draw every task as the same chain: inputs in big parentheses, a labelled block arrow for the model, then the output.
